package private

import (
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestDiagnosticPlanningRecoveryIsTeacherOnlyNoStoreAndRejectsCallerInputs(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(handlers.HealthHandler{}, handlers.CoursePlanHandler{}, handlers.TargetCatalogHandler{}, handlers.PracticeLearningHandler{}, handlers.LearningReadinessHandler{}, handlers.OnboardingPlanHandoffHandler{}, handlers.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanHandler{}, handlers.DiagnosticPlacementHandler{}, handlers.ProjectAuthoringHandler{}, "general", "teacher", "teacher-handoff", "practice")
	path := "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/diagnostic-assessment-plans/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/planning-state"
	for _, token := range []string{"", "general", "practice", "teacher-handoff", "teacher"} {
		r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
		r.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		want := http.StatusForbidden
		if token == "teacher" {
			want = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity
		}
		if w.Code != want {
			t.Fatalf("token=%q status=%d", token, w.Code)
		}
		if token == "teacher" && w.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
			t.Fatal("missing no-store")
		}
	}
	for _, query := range []string{"?goal=other", ""} {
		r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path+query, strings.NewReader(`{"goal":"other"}`))
		r.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher")
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		if w.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Fatalf("caller input status=%d", w.Code)
		}
	}
}
